items.title: Solana attracts $552M net inflows as users flee Ethereum, Arbitrum – What’s next?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The $552M net inflows into Solana indicate a significant shift in user preference, enhancing SOL's liquidity and positioning within the competitive landscape.

items.title: Microsoft Says MDASH Beats Claude Mythos and GPT-5.6 Sol in Cybersecurity Test
items.whyYouShouldCare: Microsoft's MDASH outperforming competitors in cybersecurity tests highlights the potential for Solana's ecosystem to integrate advanced technologies, boosting its appeal to developers.

items.title: Ethereum, Solana and Avalanche get busier and cheaper even as token prices fall: Bitwise
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increased activity and reduced costs on Solana, Ethereum, and Avalanche suggest growing user engagement, which could drive higher transaction volumes and ecosystem growth for SOL.
